about_the_game:
About this DEMO

At present, the DEMO only provides the hotel area in the first chapter, including guest room corridors, libraries, mushroom rooms, backyards, broken bridges, and some CG. Subsequent DEMO updates will continue to expand the area, CG, and optimize game content

Explore the intricate Hundred Window Court Hotel; walk immersively through the snowy 80's Chinese countryside; or watch out for monsters from the darkness of an abandoned factory. LOSTLIMINAL is a quirky first-person exploration and deconstruction game based on the BackRoom urban legend! Players will take on the role of a wanderer lost in the backroom hierarchy, searching for their past in a variety of surreal threshold spaces and determining the ultimate outcome based on their choices!

Surreal anomalous spaces

Created by the original art team of Lost in the Back Room, we present you with the beauty from the threshold space. With intricate spatial intersections, delicate and realistic light and shadow effects, you will be immersed in a geometrical space made up of all kinds of anomalies.

Memory and reality are intertwined, fear and darkness go hand in hand, can you find the right way out to retrieve your own memories.

Exclusive one-man show

Presented exclusively by TUJI Studio, from the memories of a ‘wanderer’ lost in the liminal space. He finds his own memories in the cycle of reincarnation and death. In the midst of various spatial anomalies, he puts together the pieces of his memory, and searches for the key to leaving the hierarchy based on his past memories. When the truth emerges, choose whether or not to stay in Threshold Space, even if you are no longer human.

Revolutionary Gameplay

The technical team has finally come up with a revolution, a quantum leap in gameplay and quality compared to Lost in the Backroom! Find fragments of memories you once had amidst the spatial disarray; piece together the puzzle of anomalies scattered around; search for anomalies that don't belong in the midst of heavy spatial dilemmas and chaos, and use that anomaly to leave the ever-reincarnating layers.
